messages.content: Welcome! What is your role in the municipality?
I lead the finance team. We are a large municipality, so the grant was a small part of our budget.
What would you change in the scheme?
Simpler reporting. Ask [PERSON_1] if you need the figures.

summary: Finance lead in a large municipality who wants simpler reporting.

messages.content: Welcome! What is your role in the municipality?
I am [PERSON_1], [the person responsible for grants] in [a small municipality in Northern Norway]. I have done this alone [for some time].
How did the application go for [the municipality]?
Fine. I called the directorate twice, and they were helpful.

summary: [Person responsible for grants] in [a small municipality in Northern Norway], working alone [for some time].
